channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Project Hospital - Department of Infectious Diseases
item.description: Project Hospital - Department of Infectious Diseases contains 65 different diagnoses and comes with new specialized equipment, isolation ward, new ambulance, sandbox level, events and outbreaks!

item.title: Project Hospital - Traumatology Department
item.description: Project Hospital - Traumatology Department contains 35 different diagnoses and comes with helicopter, new specialized equipment, wheelchairs, sandbox level and new events!

item.title: PANICORE
item.description: PANICORE is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

item.title: Project Hospital - Hospital Services
item.description: Hospital Services expansion pack introduces Administrative department with pharmacy, cafeteria, janitor management, staff training and visitors. Pathology department allows you to figure out what went wrong with your lost cases.

item.title: Vivid World
item.description: A follow-up to the hit game Vivid Knight, Vivid World is a completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game! Our story takes place in the Underworld, a land ruled by demons. Utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.

item.title: Project Hospital
item.description: Become an ace doctor, an aspiring architect and a successful manager at the same time. Design your very own hospital, tweak every detail or choose one of the prebuilt scenarios and just jump to the doctor’s duty.
